question: Rapid diagnostic tests for diagnosing uncomplicated non-falciparum or Plasmodium vivax malaria in endemic countries (a diagnostic-test-accuracy review: in people with suspected non-falciparum / P. vivax malaria, what is the accuracy of rapid diagnostic tests?)
eligibility: Suspected or confirmed uncomplicated non-falciparum or P. vivax malaria.
Evaluates a malaria rapid diagnostic test.
Reports diagnostic performance against an eligible reference standard.
as_of_source: day after the latest Entrez date among gold records (a lower bound on the review's search date)
source: CLEF TAR 2018 Task 2 (Testing), content-level qrels — finally-included studies of Cochrane review CD011431.
notes: Converted from the protocol-first branch. naive_blocks come from protocols written by the fixture author, some tightened while looking at the gold set, so the naive floor may be optimistic.
